title: Parcels
description: Parcels in and around Sandy City, Utah as of July, 2022. The service describes itself as current to July 2022, so it lags the county's live parcel fabric by more than three years. 106,087 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: RECORDER_DATA_AS_OF
table:columns.description: Date the recorder's ownership data in this row was current.

table:columns.name: parcel_id
table:columns.description: County parcel identification number. Unique across the 106,087 rows here, and the key that joins to `address-points.Parcel_Id`. Note the capitalisation differs between the two collections.

table:columns.name: parent_parcel
table:columns.description: Parcel this one was split from, where it is a subdivision of an earlier parcel.

table:columns.name: num_old_prcls
table:columns.description: Number of earlier parcels merged into this one.

table:columns.name: source_doc
table:columns.description: Recorded document the current ownership derives from.

table:columns.name: date_created
table:columns.description: Date the parcel was created in the recorder's system.

table:columns.name: last_vesting
table:columns.description: Reference to the document that last vested title.

table:columns.name: parcel_acres
table:columns.description: Parcel area in acres as carried on the assessment roll.

table:columns.name: own_name
table:columns.description: Owner of record. Property ownership is public record under the county recorder. This column is in the GeoParquet and deliberately not in the vector tiles.

table:columns.name: multi_names
table:columns.description: Count of owners of record, where title is held jointly.

table:columns.name: tax_dist
table:columns.description: Tax district code. A district is the unique overlap of taxing entities that applies to the parcel.

table:columns.name: care_of
table:columns.description: Care-of line on the owner's mailing address.

table:columns.name: own_addr
table:columns.description: Owner's mailing address, which is often not the property address. Public record, GeoParquet only.

table:columns.name: own_apt_num
table:columns.description: Apartment or unit number in the owner's mailing address.

table:columns.name: own_citystate
table:columns.description: City and state of the owner's mailing address.

table:columns.name: own_country_code
table:columns.description: Country of the owner's mailing address. Blank for most rows; `USA` where set explicitly.

table:columns.name: own_zip
table:columns.description: ZIP code of the owner's mailing address.

table:columns.name: own_zip_four
table:columns.description: ZIP+4 extension of the owner's mailing address.

table:columns.name: prop_location
table:columns.description: Situs address of the parcel itself.

table:columns.name: HouseNum
table:columns.description: House number of the property address.

table:columns.name: PreDir
table:columns.description: Directional prefix of the street name, such as S or E. Measured in the published file: Populated on 99% of 106,087 rows, 3 distinct values.

table:columns.name: StreetName
table:columns.description: Street name component of the address. Measured in the published file: Populated on 99% of 106,087 rows, 4,941 distinct values.

table:columns.name: StreetType
table:columns.description: Street type component of the address, such as ST or AVE. Measured in the published file: Populated on 73% of 106,087 rows, 19 distinct values.

table:columns.name: StreetDir
table:columns.description: Directional component of the property street name.

table:columns.name: exempt_type
table:columns.description: Exemption class, where the parcel is exempt from property tax.

table:columns.name: property_type
table:columns.description: Assessment property-type code.

table:columns.name: Property_Type_Desc
table:columns.description: Full assessment property-type description. `Property_Type_Simple_Desc` is the grouped form.

table:columns.name: Property_Type_Simple_Desc
table:columns.description: Grouped property type: Residential, Commercial, Condos, Land or Other.

table:columns.name: Community
table:columns.description: Sandy community area number, joining to the `communities` collection. Populated on 35% of rows.

table:columns.name: Quadrant
table:columns.description: Sandy addressing and policing quadrant. Measured in the published file: Populated on 31% of 106,087 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: CityCouncil
table:columns.description: Sandy city council district the feature falls in. Measured in the published file: Populated on 31% of 106,087 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Abnormal
table:columns.description: Marker the assessor sets on a parcel that does not fit normal valuation, such as an odd shape or a split use.

table:columns.name: Mun_Tax_Agency
table:columns.description: Municipality that levies property tax on the parcel. The layer covers parcels around Sandy as well as in it, so this is how to select Sandy's own.

table:columns.name: Township
table:columns.description: Township of the Public Land Survey System description.

table:columns.name: Range
table:columns.description: Range of the Public Land Survey System description.

table:columns.name: Section
table:columns.description: Section of the Public Land Survey System description.

table:columns.name: Annexation
table:columns.description: Annexation that brought the parcel into the city.

table:columns.name: Lot
table:columns.description: Lot number within the recorded subdivision.

table:columns.name: Subdivision
table:columns.description: Recorded subdivision the parcel lies in.

table:columns.name: ASSESSOR_DATA_VALID_FOR
table:columns.description: Tax year the assessor's valuation columns apply to.

table:columns.name: neighborhood_code
table:columns.description: Assessor's neighbourhood code. Comparable sales are drawn from within a neighbourhood when valuing a parcel.

table:columns.name: nbhrd_low_sale
table:columns.description: Lowest comparable sale price in the assessor's neighbourhood, in dollars.

table:columns.name: nbhrd_high_sale
table:columns.description: Highest comparable sale price in the neighbourhood.

table:columns.name: nbhrd_av_sale
table:columns.description: Average comparable sale price in the neighbourhood.

table:columns.name: new_growth_value
table:columns.description: Value attributed to new construction in the assessment year, which a taxing entity may levy on outside its certified rate.

table:columns.name: nbrhd_av_home_sf
table:columns.description: Average home floor area in the neighbourhood, in square feet.

table:columns.name: abv_grnd_sf
table:columns.description: Above-ground floor area in square feet, excluding basements.

table:columns.name: multi_structure
table:columns.description: Marker for a parcel carrying more than one structure.

table:columns.name: tax_year
table:columns.description: Tax year the valuation columns apply to.

table:columns.name: greenbelt_acres
table:columns.description: Acres assessed under Utah's Farmland Assessment Act, which values qualifying agricultural land on its productive value rather than its market value.

table:columns.name: full_mkt_prcl_total
table:columns.description: Full market value of the parcel, land and buildings, in dollars.

table:columns.name: full_mkt_total_land
table:columns.description: Full market value of the land alone.

table:columns.name: adjusted_prcl_total
table:columns.description: Parcel value after adjustments such as the residential exemption.

table:columns.name: adjusted_total_land
table:columns.description: Land value after adjustments.

table:columns.name: full_mkt_total_bldg
table:columns.description: Full market value of the buildings alone.

table:columns.name: adjusted_total_bldg
table:columns.description: Building value after adjustments.

table:columns.name: total_full_mkt
table:columns.description: Total full market value carried on the roll.

table:columns.name: total_adjusted
table:columns.description: Total adjusted value carried on the roll.

table:columns.name: total_assessed
table:columns.description: Assessed value in dollars before exemptions.

table:columns.name: taxable_value
table:columns.description: Taxable value in dollars for the stated tax year, after exemptions.

table:columns.name: year_built
table:columns.description: Year the principal building was constructed. Zero or null where the parcel carries no building.

table:columns.name: total_sq_ft
table:columns.description: Building floor area in square feet, where a building is assessed on the parcel.

table:columns.name: num_housing_units
table:columns.description: Number of dwelling units on the parcel.

table:columns.name: lot_use
table:columns.description: Assessor's land-use code for the lot.

table:columns.name: zip_two
table:columns.description: Secondary ZIP code, where the parcel spans two.

table:columns.name: tax_class1
table:columns.description: Primary tax class code.

table:columns.name: Tax_Class1_Desc
table:columns.description: Description of the primary tax class.

table:columns.name: tax_class2
table:columns.description: Second tax class code, where a parcel carries more than one.

table:columns.name: Tax_Class2_Desc
table:columns.description: Description of the second tax class.

table:columns.name: tax_class3
table:columns.description: Third tax class code.

table:columns.name: Tax_Class3_Desc
table:columns.description: Description of the third tax class.

table:columns.name: tax_rate
table:columns.description: Combined tax rate applied to the parcel.

table:columns.name: Garbage
table:columns.description: Whether the parcel receives Sandy City garbage collection.

table:columns.name: Legal_Description
table:columns.description: Recorded legal description of the parcel.

table:columns.name: Shape__Area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: Tax_District_2022
table:columns.description: Tax district as of the 2022 roll.

table:columns.name: Sensitive_Overlay
table:columns.description: Whether the parcel falls in the Sensitive Area Overlay zone, which constrains development on the mountain front.

table:columns.name: Historic_Tiers
table:columns.description: Historic designation tier applying to the parcel.

table:columns.name: Wildland_Interface
table:columns.description: Whether the parcel falls in the wildland urban interface, where wildfire risk governs building standards.

table:columns.name: Floodplain
table:columns.description: Whether the parcel intersects the mapped floodplain.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
